confidence: Internal heuristic only; explicitly not probability
overlap_handling: One label per candidate; near-simultaneous low/high evidence becomes ratio-based or uncertain; no creative thinning applied
quality_finding: The 5 kick / 367 snare-like / 3 uncertain imbalance indicates high-frequency arrangement transients likely dominate. No ground-truth drum stem or annotated truth set exists, so precision/recall cannot be measured.
strength: broadband/low/snare-band robust z values retained per event
timing_grid: 10ms hop; each event also mapped to nearest 30fps frame
